data.narrative:
First Light Fusion, a Series C nuclear energy company founded by Nicholas Hawker and Yiannis Ventikos, has raised over $100M to date. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable valuation method here. Using the $100M in total capital raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement yields an implied valuation of $170M. A peer-median approach cannot be reliably applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the nuclear energy segment—only one adjacent-stage datapoint exists in the narrow filter, below the three-company threshold required for robust benchmarking.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $144M to $195M, with a median estimate of $170M. This single-method triangulation carries meaningful uncertainty around timing and definition of comparable company stage equivalency. The primary risk to valuation lies in the limited depth of late-stage nuclear energy private company data; macro shifts in nuclear policy and energy commodity pricing also represent material but unquantified variables.
